items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: His mother and my mother in Omaha, Nebraska, Mrs. Louise Kelly, were friends.

ctx.x: was the cause of Coleman Hawkins [St. Joseph] first leaving his home in St. Joe, Missouri. Milt, there's something that very few people know. Coleman Hawkins had a ring and I had a ring, and I still have it. His mother and my mother in Omaha, Nebraska, Mrs. Louise Kelly, were friends.
Who's Mrs. Louise Kelly, your mother?
